projects.title: Greenbone Vulnerability Management Lab
projects.description: Deployment and configuration of GVM / OpenVAS on Ubuntu Server in a VMware virtualized environment.
projects.details: A documented infrastructure lab covering Ubuntu preparation, dependencies, PostgreSQL, GVM components, service configuration, web interface setup, SSH administration, troubleshooting, and setup verification.
projects.objective: Build familiarity with vulnerability-management infrastructure and the operational steps needed to validate a working security platform.

projects.title: Play Card App
projects.description: A deployed web application demonstrating interactive gameplay and frontend application development.
projects.details: A live Play Card application deployed on Vercel and available for demonstration.
projects.objective: Build and publish an interactive web application with a usable public interface.

projects.title: SOC Analyst Practice Lab
projects.description: A hands-on security operations laboratory for practicing monitoring, alert investigation, log analysis, documentation, and response workflows.
projects.details: A structured practice environment organized around detection, investigation, analysis, documentation, and response. Incidents and findings are only added when supported by lab evidence.
projects.objective: Develop disciplined security-operations habits and clear incident documentation through repeatable exercises.

documents.title: GVM / OpenVAS Installation Guide
documents.description: A step-by-step record of the Ubuntu Server deployment and service verification process.

documents.title: Network Lab Documentation
documents.description: Virtual network topology, addressing plan, connectivity checks, and observations.

documents.title: Security Lab Reports
documents.description: Structured reports for monitoring exercises, analysis, and incident documentation.
